# App

data class [App](index.html)(val appName: [String](https://kotlinlang.org/api/latest/jvm/stdlib/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-string/index.html), val rootAgent: [BaseAgent](../../com.google.adk.kt.agents/-base-agent/index.html), val plugins: [List](https://kotlinlang.org/api/latest/jvm/stdlib/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin.collections/-list/index.html)<[Plugin](../../com.google.adk.kt.plugins/-plugin/index.html)> = emptyList(), val resumabilityConfig: [ResumabilityConfig](../../com.google.adk.kt.agents/-resumability-config/index.html)? = null, val eventsCompactionConfig: [EventsCompactionConfig](../../com.google.adk.kt.summarizer/-events-compaction-config/index.html)? = null)

Represents an LLM-backed agentic application.

An [App](index.html) is the top-level container for an agentic system powered by LLMs. It bundles an application name together with the [rootAgent](root-agent.html) that serves as the root of the agent tree, enabling coordination and communication across all agents in the hierarchy. It also carries application-wide configuration, such as [plugins](plugins.html) and [resumabilityConfig](resumability-config.html), that the runner applies to every session it runs.

[appName](app-name.html) must be a valid identifier (letters, digits, and underscores only, not starting with a digit) and must not be the reserved value `"user"`, which is reserved for end-user input. Construction throws IllegalArgumentException if [appName](app-name.html) does not meet these requirements.
